question: Can globally reassigned E-S attachments supply missing cross-E routes while retaining full-fibre helper coverage?
previous_unknown: Single deleted E-S plus one E-helper spoke repairs a helper target bottleneck, but cannot create a third endpoint between different external base fibres in <=3 steps.

changed_rule.external_core: Nine E vertices form C9, indices mod9.
changed_rule.secant_matching: Nine S-S pairs, each with exactly one endpoint s_i whose base is adjacent to chosen absolute base T=8.
changed_rule.new_ES_attachments: E_i-s_i and E_(i+4)-s_prime_i for i=0..8; all eighteen old E-S attachments are reassigned.
changed_rule.old_AS: Retain cyclic3 lift edges from twelve A-S base edges, each with a ternary shift; fix S-S pairs to identity for this concrete family.
changed_rule.ports: Delete both E-S end edges of pair0. Add helpers a-b-c. a attaches E0,E4 and one A; b attaches two A; c attaches all three T lifts. Each freed S takes one eligible A free port, remaining four A ports form two A-A edges.

predictions.claim: All nine E vertices are pairwise at distance <=3 for every structural assignment.
predictions.reason: C9 steps give offsets 1,2,3. Each S-S pair gives an offset4 path of length3. Removed pair0 is replaced by E0-a-E4 length2.

predictions.claim: c reaches all42 vertices in <=3 for every structural assignment.
predictions.reason: Its full T fibre reaches all S neighboring T in2, their S mates in3, and every A fibre in<=3. Exactly one T-neighbor S is attached to each E; the removed E0 branch is restored by c-b-a-E0.

predictions.claim: a reaches all nine E in<=3.
predictions.reason: E0 and E4 have cycle R2 sets of size5 whose union is all nine.

predictions.claim: There may be a completion of the remaining A-S shifts and free ports with all pairs D3.
predictions.evidence_limit: The three positive route-class guarantees do not imply joint coverage of remaining A/S/helper pairs. This existential prediction may be refuted.

scope: One concrete non-Cayley-assumed 42-point family with fixed C9/chord assignment and fixed deleted pair0. Does not preserve Brown13 external projection and is not covered by the prior unchanged-lift or single-ES-cut exclusions.
next_decision: Check the three positive guarantees and attack remaining route classes. If valid and no uniform obstruction, compile one exact complete-pair CNF and run a single explicitly budgeted solver call; no seed/reencoding loop.
